title: Structure preparation and lattice optimization
action: Build a 2×2×2 rocksalt MgO supercell (32 atoms), substitute one Mg with Mn. Optimize the lattice constant by DFT starting from a=4.213 Å, and write a relaxation log.
description: Lattice optimization output; not directly scored, but required for subsequent calculations.

title: DFT electronic structure calculations
action: Perform spin‑polarised SCF calculations for weak‑field (S=5/2) and strong‑field (S=1/2) configurations using LSDA and LSDA+U (Ueff=6 eV). Obtain charge densities, band structures, DOS, and magnetic moments for all four cases.
description: DFT calculations producing intermediate data for downstream extraction steps.

title: Extract electronic properties
action: Extract spin‑resolved band gaps, valence‑ and conduction‑band spin splittings, and compute exchange parameters Nα and Nβ for U=0 eV and U=6 eV.
description: Electronic band gaps and exchange parameters derived from DFT band structures.
output_schema: {"U": 0 or 6, "E_g_up": float (eV), "E_g_down": float (eV), "delta_E_c": float (meV), "delta_E_v": float (meV), "N_alpha": float (eV), "N_beta": float (eV)}

title: Extract magnetic moments
action: Extract total and site‑projected magnetic moments (Mg, Mn, O, interstitial) from DFT for U=0 eV and U=6 eV.
output_schema: {"U": 0 or 6, "Total": float (μB), "Mg": float (μB), "Mn": float (μB), "O": float (μB), "Interstitial": float (μB)}

title: Calculate optical properties
action: Compute the frequency‑dependent dielectric function ε(ω) and spin‑resolved absorption coefficient α(ω) using the DFT wavefunctions and Kramers‑Kronig relations for all four configurations.
description: Optical property calculation required for optical gap extraction.

title: Extract optical band gaps
action: Construct Tauc plots from α(ω), extract spin‑resolved optical band gaps, and compute percentage reduction of the gap in the strong‑field case relative to weak‑field for each spin and each U.
description: Spin‑resolved optical band gaps and reduction percentages.
output_schema: [{"U": 0 or 6, "ligand_field": "weak" or "strong", "E_g_up": float (eV), "E_g_down": float (eV)}, ...] + final object: {"reduction_up_U0": float (%), "reduction_down_U0": float (%), "reduction_up_U6": float (%), "reduction_down_U6": float (%)}
